style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.ch_house_turns: A tidy three-storey manor on a hilltop at the start of night, a wrap-around porch with flower boxes of marigolds and asters, warm lit windows, a red barn behind it, a neat garden gate, soft indigo evening sky with the first stars, welcoming and quiet, no people
pictures.ch_house_turns_2: The same hilltop manor now twisted, roof and eaves bent at impossible angles, a leaning turret, black mould climbing the clapboards, dead petals blowing off the flower boxes, windows gone black, a huge storm front with green lightning behind it, on the porch a tall lanky shadowy figure in a bent top hat with a huge yellow grin and limbs at wrong angles, waving one long arm
pictures.ch_portraits: A tall gilt-framed oil portrait of a stiff Victorian family in a gloomy foyer, a lanky father with a bent top hat and a huge yellow grin standing behind a seated mother, a small boy and a girl, a babe in arms, painted eyes that seem to look sideways, peeling rose wallpaper, candle glow, no lettering
pictures.ch_portraits_2: A tall gilt-framed oil portrait of a stern pale lady in a wicker choker and a crown of red-orange flowers, beside her a weeping man in dark clothes wearing a black six-pointed crown with a crescent-moon pin, tears running down his cheeks, cracked varnish, gloomy foyer wall with peeling rose wallpaper, candle glow
pictures.ch_portraits_3: A tall gilt-framed oil portrait of four travellers in cloaks, packs and weapons posed stiffly together, every face a smooth blank smear of flesh-coloured paint with a wide toothless black grin painted across it, unsettling, gloomy foyer wall with peeling rose wallpaper, candle glow
pictures.ch_apparition_1: A narrow warped hallway lit by one guttering candle, a tall lanky figure in a tattered suit and bent top hat with a huge yellow grin and a hanged man's neck rushing straight at us with a raised axe, seen over the dark shoulder and cloak of a traveller in the foreground, back of the head only, tilted floor, peeling wallpaper
pictures.ch_apparition_1_2: The same narrow warped hallway, the axe blade swinging through empty air, the lanky grinning figure stretching and smearing sideways into the rose wallpaper like wet paint, dissolving into the pattern, a traveller's gloved hand in the foreground, candle flame bent, dust drifting
pictures.ch_apparition_2: A dim upstairs hallway, a rope noose dropping from the ceiling and a tall lanky figure in a tattered suit and bent top hat hanging from it, seen mostly as a swinging silhouette against a window flash of lightning, long limbs dangling, huge yellow grin barely visible, tilted floorboards, no gore
pictures.ch_apparition_2_2: The same upstairs hallway, the dark swinging silhouette of the hanging figure slamming against the wall, a burst of plaster dust, a framed picture falling and its glass shattering, lightning in the window, a traveller's raised arm shielding in the foreground, no gore
pictures.ch_apparition_3: A narrow attic-stair landing with sloping beams, a pale body folded almost square at the middle like a bent doll, in a tattered suit and bent top hat, shuffling across the boards on its elbows and knees, huge yellow grin, one lantern on the floor throwing long shadows, dusty and cold
pictures.ch_apparition_3_2: A close view of long pale knuckled fingers bent at wrong angles sliding into a dark crack between old floorboards, the rest of the figure already gone, dust and a few splinters, one lantern throwing a warm orange light across the wood
pictures.ch_gail_freed: A huge stuffed brown bear on its hind legs in a dim trophy room, glass eyes glinting, its mouth open mid-roar, a sad middle-aged housekeeper's face with a white cap showing out of the stitched seam at its throat, taxidermy animals in unnatural poses on the walls, firelight from a hearth
pictures.ch_gail_freed_2: The same stuffed bear torn open down the chest, sawdust pouring onto the floor like sand, a translucent ghostly housekeeper in a white cap pressing a small silver pin into the bear's nose, her body fading to pale blue light from the feet up, her face calm, trophy room around her
pictures.ch_arthur_sleeps: A pair of gloved adult arms in a travelling cloak seen from above cradling a glowing translucent blue infant wrapped in a tiny shirt, the child's eyes closed at last, a dim nursery with a crib riddled with small holes behind, soft blue glow on the cloak, no face of the carer shown
pictures.ch_arthur_sleeps_2: Two empty cupped gloved hands held out in the dark nursery, glowing blue motes rising and thinning in the air past a wooden cradle with many tiny holes in it, a faded blue teddy bear lying in the cradle, gentle blue light, quiet, no face shown
pictures.ch_petunia_ribbon: A close view of a pale slender neck above a high black mourning-gown collar, a faded green ribbon tied at the throat coming loose, one end slipping free in a gloved hand, rain-streaked glass and dead vines behind, cold green light, the face out of frame, no gore
pictures.ch_petunia_ribbon_2: A glass conservatory in a storm, a soft cloud of red mist spreading across the rain-streaked panes and across the glossy leaves of a single living bergamot tree with green fruit, a black mourning gown crumpled on a bench, a porcelain teacup toppled beside it, nothing of a body shown, lightning flash
pictures.ch_house_unbends: A round attic room with a bubbling cauldron of glowing red liquid, a short wizened hag with a long pointed nose and a coat of weasel fur collapsing in on herself into a heap of human teeth that pours across the floor, red rune light on the walls, a round window behind, grotesque and dramatic
pictures.ch_house_unbends_2: A wide shot of the hilltop manor at night with the storm clearing, the twisted roofs and walls straightening back into a graceful old house, black mould draining away down the clapboards, the circular attic window glowing red and then going dark, calm stars through breaking clouds, wet grass, a dead gnarled tree at the corner
pictures.ch_house_unbends_3: A tidy pale-wood attic floor, a dignified man in a rumpled dark waistcoat and a stern elegant woman in a wicker choker blinking awake side by side with their ropes lying loose around them, warm morning-gold light from a round window, the cauldron cold and empty beside them, relieved and groggy
